questions.question: In digital arithmetic circuits, what is the primary architectural advantage of a Carry-Lookahead Adder (CLA) compared to a standard Ripple-Carry Adder (RCA)?
options: It uses significantly fewer transistors and smaller silicon area than an RCA for wide bit-widths.
It eliminates all glitches and dynamic switching hazards across the sum outputs.
It reduces propagation delay from linear O(n) to logarithmic O(log n) by precomputing carry signals in parallel using generate and propagate logic.
It operates completely asynchronously without requiring any reference clock or intermediate state registers.
It allows the addition of two floating-point mantissas in a single clock cycle without normalization.

questions.question: In microarchitecture, why is a 2-bit saturating counter (bimodal branch predictor) generally preferred over a 1-bit predictor for handling loops?
options: It prevents a single anomalous branch outcome (such as the final loop exit) from permanently flipping the prediction for the subsequent loop invocation.
It stores both the branch condition and the full 64-bit target address directly in the counter state.
It completely eliminates the need to flush the processor pipeline upon detecting a branch misprediction.
It allows the branch prediction logic to run at double the core clock frequency using dual-edge triggering.
It calculates the target branch address dynamically using an integrated arithmetic adder.

questions.question: During digital logic synthesis and optimization, what does the technique known as retiming fundamentally accomplish?
options: Dynamically modulating the clock frequency at runtime based on real-time temperature fluctuations.
Replacing static CMOS gates with dynamic domino logic to increase switching speed along critical paths.
Inserting delay buffers along the shortest paths to fix post-layout hold timing violations.
Relocating sequential storage elements (registers/flip-flops) across combinational logic boundaries to balance path delays without changing external circuit latency or functionality.
Converting synchronous flip-flops into level-sensitive transparent latches to enable cycle borrowing.

questions.question: In modern DRAM memory subsystem architectures, what is the primary operational consequence of a "Row Buffer Conflict" (or "Row Buffer Miss") during a memory read?
options: The memory controller must immediately trigger a refresh cycle across all DRAM banks to restore lost charges.
The requested data is permanently lost and must be fetched again from non-volatile storage.
The DRAM controller converts the access into an unaligned burst transfer across the peripheral bus.
The memory channel bus must be tristated and recalibrated using an on-die termination (ODT) sequence.
The currently open row must be written back and precharged to close it before an activate command can open the newly requested row, incurring additional access latency.

questions.question: In the late stages of the ASIC physical design flow, what is the primary purpose of an Engineering Change Order (ECO)?
options: Formally submitting the finalized GDSII file to the semiconductor foundry for mask fabrication.
Implementing incremental logic, functional bug fixes, or timing corrections without re-running the entire synthesis and place-and-route flow from scratch.
Converting register-transfer level (RTL) Verilog descriptions into high-level C++ system models.
Calibrating the automatic test equipment (ATE) patterns used during post-silicon wafer sorting.
Optimizing the packaging pinout and ball grid array (BGA) assignments before board-level integration.
